Alongside the conferences, an official delegation led by **H.E. Dr Ali bin Tamim, Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Arabic Language Centre and the Sheikh Zayed Book Award’s Secretary General,** will visit Italy and conduct meetings with key cultural and academic institutions.
